recommendation: Keep the commit. FHIR-core now matches the final Vocabulary and CRMI naming trail; CRMI operation-definition maintenance remains in the external CRMI IG rather than this core checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-56201 was an Applied FHIR-core CodeSystem change request from Vocabulary. The initial request asked for an invalidInVersion concept property, but the final Persuasive with Modification disposition required adding lastVersionPresent as a string concept property for expansion concepts that are explicitly referenced but no longer present in the code system version used for expansion.
initial_application: Local history shows e46b57c91b first added invalidInVersion to the active concept-properties CodeSystem source, CodeSystem narrative table, and CodeSystem change note. Commit 95e797e1e0 then applied the updated disposition by renaming that concept to lastVersionPresent and updating the definition and change notes.
additional_context: The linked Applied CRMI issue FHIR-55634 was reopened after FHIR-56201 and its final disposition renamed the CRMI ValueSet/$expand input parameter to includeNoLongerPresent. Vocabulary minutes from 2026-04-06 record the same naming discussion and the decision to reopen FHIR-55634. The CRMI implementation commit 428a46bf49a1a59f6c207352f27335570e866d4a confirms that includeNoLongerPresent is the external operation parameter and that it uses the core lastVersionPresent concept property.
reconciliation: Changed source/codesystem/codesystem-concept-properties.xml and source/codesystem/codesystem-notes.xml from includeLastVersionPresent to includeNoLongerPresent. The already-applied lastVersionPresent property code, display, datatype, and expansion semantics were preserved.
